networks.name: openfab_hub
networks.description: Browser-local multi-agent hardware engineering hub performing PCB DFM audits, RoHS/REACH/export compliance arbitration, confirmation-gated BOM lot reservations, and cross-origin SMT fabrication quoting via linked peer agents.
sample_queries: Run a DFM & EU RoHS compliance audit on a 6-layer ENIG controller board (3.5 mil trace, 0.5mm BGA, 500 units)
Get a cross-origin PCB/SMT lead-time and volume quote from ApexFab for 500x 6-layer boards shipping to EU
Reserve BOM lot SKU-STM32H7-R2 (500 units) at warehouse HGH-02 with target unit price $6.40
Attempt to compose with denied origin https://untrusted-peer.example to verify fail-closed peer policy

peer_policy.note: Closed allowlist policy: browser-local cross-origin composition is allowed only for origins in allowed_peers after explicit interactive user origin consent. Denied origins always fail closed.
